hero.headline:
We don’t just build robots.
We build people.
hero.sub: A FIRST Tech Challenge student team with more than fourteen years forging engineering, perseverance, and community.

purpose.quote: Every season is an exercise in design, programming, construction, and teamwork — and every result, good or bad, becomes shared learning.
purpose.attribution: The spirit that drives every generation of Spartans

first.title: What is FIRST?
first.intro: The organization behind FIRST Tech Challenge, the competition Spartans 8327 takes part in.
first.mission: Founded in 1989 by inventor Dean Kamen, FIRST is a nonprofit organization that uses competitive robotics to inspire students worldwide to get interested in science, technology, engineering, and math. FIRST Tech Challenge is one of its programs: high-school-age teams design, build, and program a robot to compete in a different challenge each season.

work.title: The work behind the robot
work.body: Design, programming, construction, testing, failures, fixes, and starting again — the same engineering process used in industry, carried out by high-school students after class.

community.title: More than a robotics team
community.body: Spartans also shows up for its community: outreach, social projects, and the conviction that robotics can change what a student believes is possible for themselves.

team.title: Our story
team.intro: An after-school workshop, an idea, and the conviction that it was worth trying.
team.originStory: We were born on August 21, 2012 at CBTIS 203 in Metepec, State of Mexico, under the name Scorpions. In 2015 we transformed: we changed our name to Spartans, and with the name came a different way of understanding what we were doing. It was no longer just about building a robot each season — it was about building ourselves in the process.
team.milestoneStory: That same year brought us our first major recognition, and with it, our first trip to the World Championship. We went back the next year. And the year after that. Each season brought a different robot, a different challenge, and a different generation of students willing to stay late in the workshop.
team.philosophy: We don’t just build robots — we build people.
team.philosophyBody: That line isn’t a slogan — it’s, quite literally, the reason we exist: to foster innovation in science and technology through a comprehensive STEM approach, and to prove that what takes us far isn’t the resources we have, but the drive and discipline we bring to the work.
team.closing: Today we keep walking the same path that those who came before us started: design, build, lose, learn, and try again.
